# PirateOne

> PirateOne is a free streaming hub for movies, TV series, anime, and live sports with watchlists and continue-watching across devices.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Trending movies, TV, and anime with continue-watching.
- [Movies](/movies): Browse and discover movies.
- [Series](/series): Browse TV series.
- [Anime](/anime): Anime catalogue.
- [Sports](/sports): Live sports streaming via Strike.
- [Search](/search): Search across movies, TV, and anime.
- [Watchlist](/watchlist): Your saved titles and collections.
- [Help](/help): Usage tips and troubleshooting.
